chunks: Those who believed and did the right, will be admitted to gardens with rivers flowing by, where they will abide by the leave of their Lord, with 'Peace' as their salutation.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and do righteous deeds according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the eternal abode of the faithful, emphasizing that their entry into Paradise is by God's permission (bi-idhnillah), a concept often linked in Shia exegesis to the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt. The greeting of 'Peace' (Salām) signifies the ultimate tranquility and divine favor, distinguishing the state of the believers from the worldly realm.
